body.p: The little orphan. There lived an old man. A tree, it has no branches. There was a little orphan in the tent of the old man. The orphan hunted wild reindeers, he/she fed the old man. So the old man and the orphan lived. [On] a bad day, the orphan didn't see a single wild reindeer. He came to the tent. Three days they(?) are sitting hungry. [On] the fourth day the orphan is crying. The old man says: "Why are you crying, little one?" The orphan says: "This night I saw a dream. Tomorrow there shall be a lot of reindeers around the tent. Don't go out of(?) the tent! Don't look at those reindeers! You lie in the tent for three days!" So the orphan said to the old man. In the morning many reindeers came to the tent. The old man and the orphan are lying in the tent for three days. On the fourth day the orphan says: "Now, old man, now let 's go, one has to look!" The old man stood up: "Let's go", he says. They went out(?) of the tent, they saw: There are many reindeers running. The orphan caught a reindeer calf. Having caught he/she boiled the meat and ate. Tomorrow there are again many reindeers. Again the orphan caught a reindeer calf, again he/she boiled it, again he/she ate it. So it was for one year. The old man was living very richly. People came. The people said: "How do you have so many reindeers?" The old man is silent, there is not a single word. The people went off. The old man was wandering. He was sitting at the edge of a river. The orphan says to the old man: "Stand up early in the morning tomorrow, then go to the river where you see a tree. Catch this tree!" On the other day, the old man went to the river early in the morning. He found one(?) trunk with roots. Having found he went to the tent. The orphan says: "Did you find a(?) trunk with roots, old man?" The old man says: "I have found one." The orphan says again: "Old man, make me a tambourine [out of] the trunk with roots!" The old man says: "I will do." The old man makes a tambourine. One human came. This human's daughter is sick. The human says: "My daughter is ill. Orphan, help!" The orphan says: "Tomorrow I'll go, she won't die." On the other day, the orphan and the old man went together to ill girl. They reached the tent. The orphan says: "Make a big tent!" Then they made a big tent. The orphan says again: "Bring wood! Let's heat for three days!" Then the orphan took the tambourine, he/she is shamanizing. The orphan is shamanizing five days, he/she is shamanizing five nights. The people are hungering for three days. The orphan is shamanizing. Then the people ate. Having eaten they fell asleep. The orphan is shamanizing. The people went off. The orphan is shamanizing alone. [On] the fourth day, the old man came. There the old man saw: The orphan had climbed halfway into the earth. [On] the fifth day, the old man came again. There he saw only(?) the back of the orphan. The back is shining. On the other day, the old man came again. There he doesn't see [anything], the orphan had climbed completely into the earth. The old man yelled: "Where did the orphan go?" Then the old man found a bell. Then he is ringing the bell towards the earth. The orphan jumped into the hole. There he/she says: "I went far away, a devil brought [me] to the ground of the world." The orphan was the first shaman.
